item.description: This post walks through building a Microsoft Sentinel Codeless Connector Framework (CCF) RestApiPoller connector that uses the nested API polling pattern. Instead, they use a two-step model: a list endpoint that returns identifiers, followed by a detail endpoint that accepts one identifier and returns the full record. item.title: Turn meetings into momentum with Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Most people don't need more meetings—they need meetings that lead to action. At their best, meetings drive decisions and keep work moving forward.
